verdicts.reason: A leaves out the SOLSTICE sun logo completely, so the brand is lost. Its CTA wraps onto two cramped lines jammed against the right edge, and a large empty gap is left on the left. B keeps the logo and stacks the headline over the CTA in a sensible left-to-right banner layout. However, the logo wordmark and CTA are tiny and hard to read at 320x50, the right-hand text block crowds the top and right edges, and a background dot sits close to the CTA.
